files.README.md:
# Quill & Page CDN cache purge, 2026-09-22 22:00-23:00 window

logs/purge-superseded.log is the first attempt: it was aborted at 22:05 before
any purge was sent, and the operator re-issued the whole set as the executed run.
Purge ids are stable across attempts. Only rows marked SENT were carried out.

turns.prompt: Quill & Page's CDN ran a cache purge during the 22:00-23:00 maintenance window on 2026-09-22; logs/purge-executed.log and logs/purge-superseded.log cover the two attempts. How many cache purges were carried out?
How many of those purges targeted paths under /assets/covers/?
The marketing team's banner purges (paths under /assets/marketing/) were requested through a separate ticket — leave them out and recount.
Different question: which minute of the executed run sent the most purges?
